mechanism: Atomoxetine inhibits norepinephrine reuptake which may potentiate minoxidil's sympathomimetic effects and increase cardiovascular stress; minoxidil is a vasodilator that may cause reflex tachycardia compounded by atomoxetine's noradrenergic activity.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; assess cardiovascular risk factors before combining; consider alternative ADHD medications or topical minoxidil formulations which have minimal systemic absorption.
